name: Your Name (Kimi no Na wa)
tagline: A body-swapping romance that transcends time and space
description: Two strangers find themselves linked in a bizarre way. When a connection forms, will distance be the only thing keeping them apart? Makoto Shinkai's masterpiece became the highest-grossing anime film worldwide (before Demon Slayer), blending romance, mystery, and stunning visuals.
cons: May be too melodramatic for some
